text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while tending to the fields as usual,
Chairwoman Akikawa came by.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Good day, everyone!
As always, you grow splendid vegetables!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hello!
Are you tending to the fields too, Chairwoman?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, that's part of it.
I came here because there's one thing I want to ask of you all!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Mm. Over the past year, you girls have shown great active engagement regarding nutrition.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: "Inspired by you, more and more students are gradually learning about food and nutrition. A truly great momentum is building up!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: And so, let's begin! The 1st Annual Academy Cooking Showcase!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
It is an event where students striving on the front lines
of vegetable farming are invited to present dishes
crafted with all their culinary skill!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"A great opportunity to spread awareness of the power of food to the students!
We would absolutely love for you to participate!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
A presentation where all the buono things
everyone made gather together... sounds like fun~!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Plus, we've been taking the tasting sessions
seriously all this time!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I really want to show everyone the fruits of all my studying...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice too...! Rice wants everyone to know
how delicious the veggies we all grew
together really are...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what everyone else will serve...!
My stomach's already... no, my chef's blood is boiling with excitement!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm! I had faith that
you would say that! Well then, I'm expecting great things!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, preparations for the showcase began.
Mountains of vegetables, and a grand unveiling of new menu items.
The one most fired up of all was—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: —Everyone~! I made some snacks for you~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Waaah~!? There's sooooo much food!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It's super cold out, after all~. We've got piping hot pot-au-feu, curry, ramen, and extra-spicy mapo tofu! Eat up, everyone~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It's our big presentation, after all☆
I want lots of people to experience the ultimate buono!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "So, with that said... Starting tomorrow, I'm heading out on a little journey!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Wh-Where are you going!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The main ingredients are the veggies we all grew together,
but I want to find something that will bring out their flavor the most buonissimo!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So, I'm off to the mountains, the river, the sea☆
and all my favorite Buono spots~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I understand not wanting to compromise.
And since a guardian was needed anyway,
I ended up tagging along on the adventure."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, found a *Boletus reticulatus*!
It goes ridiculously well with pasta☆
And it's amazing with veggies too, of course!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Mushrooms make our bones stronger, so they're perfect for us Umamusume! Let's keep picking more~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Over the mountains, over the seas, over the valleys~♪
Where can the tasti~est dashi broth be~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, nice☆ Today's a bumper crop of minerals!
Turn it into salted kelp, and it'll be the perfect mid-training refuel!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Nfufu~, we've gathered some great ingredients~ Everyone at the academy is gonna be so surprised~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Pairing mushrooms with veggies high in calcium
makes for a great injury-prevention meal.
Maybe I'll toss the salted kelp into a salad~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: You think so~? Fufu, the way we look at ingredients really might be changing, huh~?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
—Such ingenuity! Such uncompromising drive!
Truly magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh~, Madame Chairwoman!?
What are you doing in a place like this!?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"No, it was quite a struggle...!
However, there was something I wished to hand over to you early!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"This may serve as nothing more than a hint, but...
I believe that you all will surely produce wonderful results!
I'm counting on you!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And as the showcase drew nearer,
participants throughout the academy
could be seen fiercely vying over their dishes—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It's reeeady~! The Machitan family special,
Staff-Meal Chicken Pot-au-Feu is complete~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's add the secret prayer to this—
Nourish-come-come, protein-nom-nom...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Eat this! Here's my specialty—
Garam Masala Zenith Fire Extinguishaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Wha--!? The aura of my...
Vortex Fire Ramen is being swallowed up
by the scent of spices, ss-su!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Heheh—with this, taking the top spot at the showcase is in the bag!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—the day of the recital had finally come!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
――Now then! Let the games begin!
Everyone, bet upon the pride of your vegetables and give it your all!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, there are so many dishes lined up...!
Ah, they even have the producers' names on them.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Wait!? This table, and that one, and the one over there...
Don't all the dishes have the exact same name tag on them!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, that's exaaactly right!
Everything around here is all our cooking~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
For example, the dish over there is for sprinters!
A special curry packed with just the right amount
of protein and carbs needed for explosive power!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? S-So there are dishes designed
for Long-distance aptitudes too!?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, in that case, try this iron-rich veggie pizza!
It's packed with clams and drained tuna!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Please check out the recipes too!
It includes details on when to eat and how to build a daily routine...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh... I definitely need to take notes on this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Still... not only is the quality remarkable,
but to think you came up with such a wide variety of dishes.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Come to think of it,
we've learned so much over this past year.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: “You're right. Starting with Bourbon-san—I learned that running and eating are so deeply connected.”

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't just fill your body, but your heart as well.
I feel like I've touched upon the true depth
of what it means to eat!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
That's why I wanted everyone to taste
every last bit of our "buono"!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: We get to taste the "buono" everyone made, and everyone gets to taste our "buono"! That way we can learn from each other's "buono"—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Everyone will be able to make things that are so much more buono! And we can clash with everything we've got in our races, too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! This recital is a chanko pot
made by everyone together, right?☆

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: "What!? Is that true...!?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Don't take everything so literally!
Still, Akebono, that's one hell of a generous spirit...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Because those feelings aren't just ours alone, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, you see... the Chairwoman has been keeping a notebook of all the students' troubles for ages!
She let me see it to help inspire the cooking theme!"

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Wait, the Chairwoman?!

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Come to think of it,
I answered that survey once!
They really took the time to listen to my worries...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: *A-Ahem, cough cough...*

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
N-Now then! The purpose of holding this press conference!
Hishi Akebono has expressed it wonderfully!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
One look at your faces tells me everything.
You have drawn immense inspiration from each other's cooking,
and your passion for food has grown even stronger!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I want to make food too...! Dishes that can build a strong body! All right, let's do thissss!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna make the Teio-certified Ultimate Hachimitsu Sports Drink super popular all over the academy!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. It seems my dish—
"Koya-dofu dropped plop into Pot-au-feu"—
still has room for further improvement.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Nutritional value lies not in fine yokan alone"—
I shall dedicate myself further to my studies.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"...Thanks to the vegetables you all grow, illnesses and injuries at the academy are on the decline.
The statistical data shows it clearly!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"As Chairwoman, I offer my sincerest gratitude!
May you continue to achieve even greater feats!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Then lastly, as a token of our appreciation!
—Hishi Akebono, you're up!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay! Alright everyone!
Gather all your veggies into this giant pot~!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why's that?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu~ time for the finale!
Let's bring everyone's buono together as one!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaa~! A full-power buono chanko pot-au-feu
packed with all the buono from across the academy is ready~!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Please, everyone line up over here!
We have small plates ready too!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I have to be careful not to spill it... Hehe, it smells so good~...!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: T-Thanks for the food!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
Ah! S-So delicious...! With every bite,
my whole body gets all warm and cozy...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, of course☆ It's a hundred-times-buono hot pot
filled with everyone's buono, after all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep making lots of buono things together!
We'll fill the whole academy with buono!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the showcase was a massive hit—
becoming the catalyst for a whole-school
food craze.
